$comment: Compressed npm download size must be strictly below 10 MB decimal (10,000,000 bytes). The historical baseline is informational for packed size. The editor data (@aceshooting/lyra-ide) and the locale catalogs (@aceshooting/lyra-translations) ship in companion packages, so the unpacked ceiling now enforces the 25% reduction from that baseline without an exception; file-count derivation reserves seven artifacts beyond the measured 308-alias inventory. Each companion has its own hard ceilings under `companions`. Required public artifacts and artifact hygiene are validated independently of every size ceiling. The UI unpacked ceiling covers the exact 20,989,217-byte estimate with 31 bytes of allowance; the actual archive measures 20,988,616 bytes after manifest normalization. The translations unpacked and IDE packed ceilings cover exact measurements of 5,823,466 and 1,657,629 bytes with 22 and 35 bytes of allowance. All other package ceilings and the historical reduction baseline remain unchanged. The final 29.1.0 changelog section raises the UI estimate to 20,989,500 bytes; its ceiling advances to the next 64-byte boundary, as does the translations unpacked ceiling over its 5,823,499-byte measurement. 29.2.0: the UI unpacked estimate of 20,998,169 bytes (regional catalogs, translation tooling docs, coverage-neutral source) advances its ceiling to 20,998,208; four regional catalogs add 41 translation files, so the translations file ceiling is 911 and its unpacked ceiling advances to 5,838,912 over a 5,838,869-byte measurement. The 29.2.0 changelog sections raise the UI unpacked estimate to 21,000,814, the translations unpacked size to 5,839,097 and the IDE packed size to 1,657,673 bytes; each ceiling advances to the next 64-byte boundary. 29.2.x: the pnpm skills-approval note raises the UI unpacked estimate to 21,000,964 bytes; its ceiling advances to the next 64-byte boundary. The 29.2.1 changelog sections raise the UI unpacked estimate to 21,001,432 bytes and the translations unpacked size to 5,839,226 bytes; each ceiling advances to the next 64-byte boundary. The 29.2.2 chart color correction and release notes measure 21,002,693 unpacked UI bytes; the translations release notes measure 5,839,322 unpacked bytes. Only these two ceilings advance to the next 64-byte boundary. 30.0.0: the immutable identity collections, lr-map camera commands, the immutable-collections migration rule and the v29 to v30 migration guide measure 21,044,702 unpacked UI bytes; its ceiling advances to the next 64-byte boundary. The same 30.0.0 change grows the editor data (@aceshooting/lyra-ide) to 1,660,919 packed bytes; its packed ceiling advances to the next 64-byte boundary. Map overlays, their public declarations and documentation measure 21,080,185 unpacked UI bytes; generated editor data measures 1,663,119 packed and 10,355,047 unpacked bytes. Only these three failing ceilings advance to the next 64-byte boundary.
